source.artifactPolicy: Generated editorial JSON, embedded API search index and PDFs are release artifacts. Versioned policy, transformer, verifier, tests and two exact UI-binding patches preserve reproducibility without committing unrelated workspace changes.
source.aboutSource: The deployed About redesign predates this task and is not yet represented in Git. Its exact one-line title change is versioned in the UI-binding patch with production before/after hashes; the unrelated redesign was not staged.

artifacts.before: before/ contains all 1,722 original content/index/PDF files; before-source/ preserves both UI sources
artifacts.prepared: prepared/ contains reviewed JSON, PDFs, render reports and visual QA evidence
artifacts.applicationReceipt: applied-files.json contains exact before/after SHA-256 hashes for all 1,722 files

verification.productionWebBuildAndTypeScript: passed against reconstructed production source plus only the two title bindings
verification.previewHTML: 860 HTTP 200 pages with exact H1, metadata, Open Graph and Article titles
verification.pdfRenderOverflowChecks: 860 passed; existing local images only, network fetch disabled
verification.pdfVisualReview: Longest-title cover inspected in every language, including Arabic, Chinese and Japanese
verification.browserLayouts: 20 longest-title page layouts at 390px/1440px; 9 directory/About checks at 320px/390px/1440px, with representative screenshots inspected
verification.searchProjection: Existing builder --check passed for all 90 entries
verification.goSearchRegression: All 860 translated-title queries, translated-title regression and pagination/scope tests passed
verification.baselineLimitations: Known unrelated Go editorial query expectations were documented in the preceding release; this release used targeted guide-search tests, not a claim of a clean full repository suite
verification.browserFallback: In-app browser bootstrap failed with missing sandboxPolicy; headless Chrome used for local QA with external requests blocked or fulfilled from existing local assets

deployment.releaseMethod: Replayed exact latest production API and web source/overlay chains. API changes only its embedded guide index. Web applies two hash-guarded title bindings and 1,721 verified guide JSON/PDF files; the current live web digest supplies existing runtime content before the overlay. Runtime content preimage/final hashes validated. Both zero-traffic candidates passed before promotion.

permissions.deployment: User authorized Google Cloud for deployment only. No translation service or database operation was used.
